items.title: Google Cloud C4 Brings a 70% TCO improvement on GPT OSS with Intel and Hugging Face
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: 谷歌云C4实例通过与英特尔和Hugging Face合作，在运行开源大模型时实现了高达70%的总拥有成本（TCO）降低。这一基础设施层面的优化为企业在主流CPU上大规模部署和运行开源语言模型提供了高性价比的选择，有助于推动LLM在生产环境中的广泛落地和成本控制。

items.title: Introducing Agent Skills
items.summary: Claude can now use Skills to improve how it performs specific tasks. Skills are folders that include instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude can load when needed. Claude will only access a skill when it's relevant to the task at hand.
